title: Decree nisi
html_source: A decree that does not take effect until/unless a certain condition is met. Originally (and still commonly) used for things like divorces to allow for a cooling-off period: the divorce decree would not take effect until a certain period of time (e.g., 30 days) had elapsed. From the Latin nisi, meaning “unless”.
